entities.name: Auguste André Thomas Cahours
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: August André Thomas Cahours (1813–1891) was a French chemist and scientist who contributed to organic chemistry by discovering, among other things, the processes of synthesis of several chemical molecules, including toluene, xylene, several organo-magnesiums, and derivatives of phosphine and arsine.

entities.summary: August André Thomas Cahours (1813–1891) was a French chemist and scientist who contributed to organic chemistry by discovering, among other things, the processes of synthesis of several chemical molecules, including toluene, xylene, several organo-magnesiums, and derivatives of phosphine and arsine.
